export declare const KNOWLEDGE_BRIEF_MAX_CHARS = 300;

export declare const KNOWLEDGE_CARD_MAX_KEYWORDS = 10;

export declare const KNOWLEDGE_CARD_STATES: readonly ["pending", "ready", "listed", "failed", "over_quota", "missing"];

export declare const KNOWLEDGE_GLOB_MAX_FILES = 500;

export declare const KNOWLEDGE_GLOB_MAX_FOLDERS = 400;

export declare const KNOWLEDGE_GREP_MAX_FILES = 50;

export declare const KNOWLEDGE_GREP_MAX_SUBJECTS = 20;

export declare const KNOWLEDGE_KEYWORD_MAX_CHARS = 30;

export declare const KNOWLEDGE_MANAGE_PERMISSION = "knowledge:manage";

export declare const KNOWLEDGE_PERMISSIONS: readonly ["knowledge:read", "knowledge:manage"];

export declare const KNOWLEDGE_PROVIDER_ID = "system.knowledge";

export declare const KNOWLEDGE_READ_DEFAULT_CHARS = 6000;

export declare const KNOWLEDGE_READ_MAX_CHARS = 12000;

export declare const KNOWLEDGE_READ_PERMISSION = "knowledge:read";

export declare const KNOWLEDGE_SECTION_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS = 200;

export declare const KNOWLEDGE_TITLE_MAX_CHARS = 120;

export interface KnowledgeCard {
    subject: ActionSubject;
    revision: string;
    title: string;
    plugin_id: string;
    plugin_title: string;
    updated_at: string | null;
    matched: KnowledgeMatchLayer;
    hint: string;
    brief: string | null;
    keywords: string[];
    open: SearchOpenTarget | null;
}

export interface KnowledgeCardFields {
    title: string;
    brief: string;
    keywords: string[];
}

export interface KnowledgeCardMatch {
    subject: ActionSubject;
    field: "title" | "card";
}

export interface KnowledgeCardRecord extends KnowledgeCardFields {
    project_id: string;
    subject: ActionSubject;
    source_key: string;
    provider_id: string;
    plugin_id: string;
    plugin_title: string;
    content_policy: "context" | "summary";
    revision: string;
    organized_revision: string | null;
    state: KnowledgeCardState;
    outline: KnowledgeSectionNote[];
    edited: KnowledgeEditableField[];
    suggestion: Partial<KnowledgeCardFields> | null;
    excluded: boolean;
    error: string | null;
    updated_at: string | null;
    organized_at: string | null;
    open: SearchOpenTarget | null;
}

export type KnowledgeCardState = "pending" | "ready" | "listed" | "failed" | "over_quota" | "missing";

export interface KnowledgeCardStorePort {
    get(projectId: string, subject: ActionSubject): KnowledgeCardRecord | null;
    list(projectId: string): KnowledgeCardRecord[];
    put(record: KnowledgeCardRecord): void;
    remove(projectId: string, subject: ActionSubject): void;
    removeProject(projectId: string): number;
    search(projectId: string, query: string, limit: number): KnowledgeCardMatch[];
    usage(projectId: string, day: string): KnowledgeUsage;
    addUsage(projectId: string, day: string, delta: Partial<Omit<KnowledgeUsage, "day">>): void;
    close(): void;
}

export interface KnowledgeCardsRequest {
    states?: KnowledgeCardState[];
    limit?: number;
    offset?: number;
}

export interface KnowledgeCardsResponse {
    cards: KnowledgeCardRecord[];
    total: number;
    quota: KnowledgeQuota;
}

export interface KnowledgeEditRequest {
    subject: ActionSubject;
    title?: string;
    brief?: string;
    keywords?: string[];
    adopt?: KnowledgeEditableField[];
}

export type KnowledgeEditableField = "title" | "brief" | "keywords";

export interface KnowledgeExcludeRequest {
    subject: ActionSubject;
    excluded: boolean;
}

export interface KnowledgeGlobFile {
    subject: ActionSubject;
    workspace_id: string;
    workspace_name: string;
    path: string;
}

export interface KnowledgeGlobRequest {
    pattern: string;
    workspace_id?: string;
    limit?: number;
}

export interface KnowledgeGlobResponse {
    files: KnowledgeGlobFile[];
    more: boolean;
    unread: Array<{
        workspace_id: string;
        path: string;
        reason: string;
    }>;
}

export interface KnowledgeGrepMatch {
    subject: ActionSubject;
    revision: string;
    line: number;
    text: string;
    before: string[];
    after: string[];
}

export interface KnowledgeGrepRequest {
    pattern: string;
    subjects?: ActionSubject[];
    glob?: string;
    workspace_id?: string;
    context_lines?: number;
    limit?: number;
}

export interface KnowledgeGrepResponse {
    matches: KnowledgeGrepMatch[];
    more: boolean;
    unread: Array<{
        subject: ActionSubject;
        reason: string;
    }>;
}

export type KnowledgeMatchLayer = "title" | "summary" | "content" | "card";

export interface KnowledgeOrganizeRequest {
    subjects?: ActionSubject[];
    confirm_over_quota?: boolean;
}

export interface KnowledgeOrganizeResponse {
    queued: number;
    quota: KnowledgeQuota;
}

export interface KnowledgeOutline {
    subject: ActionSubject;
    revision: string;
    title: string;
    length: number;
    owner_truncated: boolean;
    sections: KnowledgeSection[];
}

export interface KnowledgeOutlineRequest {
    subject: ActionSubject;
}

export interface KnowledgeQuota {
    day: string;
    used_pieces: number;
    used_chars: number;
    limit_pieces: number;
    limit_chars: number;
    reached: boolean;
}

export interface KnowledgeReadRequest {
    subject: ActionSubject;
    anchor?: string;
    offset?: number;
    max_chars?: number;
}

export interface KnowledgeReadResponse {
    subject: ActionSubject;
    revision: string;
    title: string;
    layer: "original";
    text: string;
    start: number;
    end: number;
    remaining: number;
    owner_truncated: boolean;
}

export interface KnowledgeSearchRequest {
    query: string;
    kinds?: string[];
    plugins?: string[];
    limit?: number;
}

export interface KnowledgeSearchResponse {
    status: SearchQueryStatus;
    cards: KnowledgeCard[];
}

export interface KnowledgeSection {
    anchor: string;
    title: string;
    level: number;
    start: number;
    length: number;
    summary: string | null;
}

export interface KnowledgeSectionNote {
    anchor: string;
    title: string;
    summary: string;
}

export interface KnowledgeUsage {
    day: string;
    pieces: number;
    chars: number;
    extra_pieces: number;
    extra_chars: number;
}

export declare const knowledgeActions: {
    search: ActionDefinition<KnowledgeSearchRequest, KnowledgeSearchResponse>;
    outline: ActionDefinition<KnowledgeOutlineRequest, KnowledgeOutline>;
    read: ActionDefinition<KnowledgeReadRequest, KnowledgeReadResponse>;
    grep: ActionDefinition<KnowledgeGrepRequest, KnowledgeGrepResponse>;
    glob: ActionDefinition<KnowledgeGlobRequest, KnowledgeGlobResponse>;
};

export declare const knowledgeManageActions: {
    cards: ActionDefinition<KnowledgeCardsRequest, KnowledgeCardsResponse>;
    edit: ActionDefinition<KnowledgeEditRequest, KnowledgeCardRecord>;
    exclude: ActionDefinition<KnowledgeExcludeRequest, KnowledgeCardRecord>;
    organize: ActionDefinition<KnowledgeOrganizeRequest, KnowledgeOrganizeResponse>;
};
